plate.webp.title: Mimosa pudica (Sensitive Plant), plate 544
plate.webp.maker: Henry C. Andrews (drawn, engraved and hand-coloured)
plate.webp.publication: The Botanist's Repository for New, and Rare Plants, vol. 8, pl. 544
plate.webp.source: https://www.plantillustrations.org/illustration.php?id_illustration=111905 (scan of the Biodiversity Heritage Library copy)
plate.webp.changes: Trimmed 14 px (gutter) and 30 px (gilt edge) off the scan's left and top; resized from 2872 to 2200 px wide (Lanczos).

mimosa-leaf.webp.what: the plate's great lower leaf, its colour un-mixed from the paper under it (RGB) and its coverage (alpha), in the leaf's box

mimosa-clean.webp.what: the same box with the leaf lifted off: paper tone and grain copied from the plate's own bare paper, the stalk's overlap on other leaves reconstructed (OpenCV FSR); alpha marks the lifted area

mimosa-ids.png.what: piece id per pixel: petiole and hub, 4 rachises, 255 leaflets

mimosa.json.what: the pieces: pulvinules (pivots), axes, sides, ranks along each pinna; pinna paths; primary pulvinus and hub
